statusLegend.verified: Covered by docs or code and ready for conformance tests.
statusLegend.covered: Supported through standard tooling or existing sei-js helpers, but not yet backed by a dedicated parity test.
statusLegend.partial: A path exists, but examples, helpers, typing, or tests are incomplete.
statusLegend.planned: Needed for the target and not yet represented clearly.
statusLegend.not-core: Useful in some ecosystems, but excluded from the core parity score.
statusLegend.network-limited: The SDK can expose the behavior, but the chain intentionally differs from Ethereum.
